gloss: one set; one pair; one group

definitions.explanation: A single set or pair of items that go together, such as a set of dishes, a pair of gloves, or a deck of cards.
A single group of people, or the first class/group in a school or organizational division. Japanese schools typically label classes by number: 一組, 二組, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦トランプ→トランプ：03864_toranpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一組|ひとくみ}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought one deck of playing cards.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{湯|ゆ}のみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一組|ひとくみ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a matching set of a rice bowl and a teacup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一組|ひとくみ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧{一組|ひとくみ}です。
examples.english: My son is in Year 3, Class 1.

examples.japanese: {一組|ひとくみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運動場|うんどうじょう}→運動場：21813_undoujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Students in Class 1, please gather at the sports field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれていて→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧、うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一組|ひとくみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: This year's first graders are divided into five classes, and my child was placed in Class 1.

notes:
Composed of {一|ひと} (one) and ⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧ (set, group, class). The counter ⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧ is used for things that form a natural set or group. The reading is native Japanese (ひとくみ), not Sino-Japanese (いちくみ), following the pattern for small numbers with native counters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一組|ひとくみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧: one couple
- {一組|ひとくみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧: one set of bedding
- {一組|ひとくみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧: one married couple

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {一組|ひとくみ}: one set
- {二組|ふたくみ}: two sets
- {三組|さんくみ}: three sets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一対|いっつい}→一対：08928_ittsui⟧: one pair — more formal, used for symmetrical pairs like a pair of vases
- ⟦{一式|いっしき}→一式：15714_isshiki⟧: one complete set — implies all the necessary pieces of a full set, like a toolkit or uniform set
- {一揃|ひとそろ}い: one matching set — emphasizes that items are matched or coordinated
